methods: Actual equipped production-pistol BeginFire/StopFire, original spread, scripted aim and pawn-position fixtures; test ammo is refilled through SetAmmo without saving weapon defaults.
Explicit body/weak lesson entry isolates unchanged pickup/ammo/reload prerequisites. Static-weakpoint -> moving-weakpoint -> paired-plank -> melee-preview progression is automatic.
Native time-ability ToggleTimeAbility freezes/releases actual BP_TimeBullet instances; no simulated support-hit injection or injected enemy damage in the final matrix.
Reverse-side entry and reversed support order check both surviving-hinge geometry and actual three confirmed animated deaths.
Threat HUD visibility is deliberately shown as a fixture, then normal StopThreats must hide it.
limits: Scoped editor PIE, not a continuous full-tutorial playthrough, physical mouse/keyboard feel acceptance, packaging or networking.
Slab motion is a controlled kinematic pivot/fall with one pose-based capsule-overlap strike, not a free rigid-body constraint simulation.
Original pistol additive-animation warnings remain; scoped runtime error count is checked separately.
fixture_correction: An early cold fixture held FullStop beyond its normal energy threshold; final retest uses normal input timing. No production energy defaults were changed.
